blocks.text: Buyable definition for in-game purchases. A buyable is repeatable unless once.

BuyableDef = { name: string // Display name shown in purchase UI description?: string // Optional longer description imageUrl?: string // Optional image URL shown in purchase UI priceSpoins: number // Price in Spoins; with `minSpoins`, the amount the checkout opens at minSpoins?: number // Pay what you want: the smallest amount the player may choose in Spawn's checkout (1 to `priceSpoins`); the amount the player chooses is the one charged, and `ctx.purchase.priceSpoins` reads it onPurchase?: ScriptRef | ScriptRef[] // Optional script ref(s) exporting `onPurchase(ctx, buyer)`, ctx first like every other hook: `ctx` is the ObjectAPI bound to the buyer's entity and `ctx.purchase` carries the purchase record ({ buyableId, transactionId, priceSpoins, … }); `buyer` is the purchasing player. The pre-6.0 `onPurchase(ctx, api)` shape (the record first) is not honored: the up-converter re-spells it and names the record's reads in its residue. If omitted, purchase is donation-only (no gameplay mutation). once?: boolean // One per account: a second purchase by an account that already holds this buyable is refused at the price sheet ("you already own this"). What an account holds is the platform's record: `player.state.purchases[buyableId]` → `{ transactionId, at }` on every client, written by no client. Omitted = repeatable (a consumable, a tip). }

BuyableDef = {
  name: string   // Display name shown in purchase UI
  description?: string   // Optional longer description
  imageUrl?: string   // Optional image URL shown in purchase UI
  priceSpoins: number   // Price in Spoins; with `minSpoins`, the amount the checkout opens at
  minSpoins?: number   // Pay what you want: the smallest amount the player may choose in Spawn's checkout (1 to `priceSpoins`); the amount the player chooses is the one charged, and `ctx.purchase.priceSpoins` reads it
  onPurchase?: ScriptRef | ScriptRef[]   // Optional script ref(s) exporting `onPurchase(ctx, buyer)`, ctx first like every other hook: `ctx` is the ObjectAPI bound to the buyer's entity and `ctx.purchase` carries the purchase record ({ buyableId, transactionId, priceSpoins, … }); `buyer` is the purchasing player. The pre-6.0 `onPurchase(ctx, api)` shape (the record first) is not honored: the up-converter re-spells it and names the record's reads in its residue. If omitted, purchase is donation-only (no gameplay mutation).
  once?: boolean   // One per account: a second purchase by an account that already holds this buyable is refused at the price sheet ("you already own this"). What an account holds is the platform's record: `player.state.purchases[buyableId]` → `{ transactionId, at }` on every client, written by no client. Omitted = repeatable (a consumable, a tip).
}
